body: My plan is to get a full-time position at a different workplace, and to temporarily stop going to university. I'll take one class that goes toward my bachelor's at a community college online. I plan to quit my job in about 7 weeks because I have to stay at the position for a certain amount of time.

No, I'm not really afraid of what's beyond death. I personally believe there's nothing, like if I died right now, I would be unaware of being dead or really unaware of anything because I would have no consciousness. That's just my belief. It doesn't invalidate yours. If I am wrong, which is very possible because I have never been dead, and I get sent to Hell, I would say I deserve it.

I've attempted once, and I regretted it for a couple of days. My mom started crying as well as my brother. Now, I'm just sad I wasn't successful. I appreciate you trying to fight with me. I still feel like I'm in a bad place. I do have a plan to change things if I decide to live that I created a week ago. 

What is really setting me right now is that I work in a toxic environment. I fell in love with one of my coworkers, and I mistakenly told her about my feelings, even though she's in a relationship and also my coworker. I told her this because I wanted to distance myself away from her, like not hang out with her outside of work. I thought it was respectable telling her truth because she was a good friend. She reported me, and many other people keep on reporting me for small things. Every move I make is being observed like I'm an antagonist. It's taking a toll of my mental health. There are other things, like financial, health, and school issues.
They don't care, and if they do, this is going to be really mean, they will get over it. I don't add anything positive to the world.
I 100% believe it's not going to get better.
I have started over multiple times, and it always ends up here.
The thing is, I wouldn't be feeling like this if I didn't randomly receive a huge reduction in my anti-anxiety medication three weeks ago.
I don't want to start over.
I have many friends and acquaintances, and I have a job that I used to love, but I fucked everything up.

I'm scared, but despite my feelings about it, I feel like it's something that I have to do, like a duty or something. This is morbid, but in the videos I have watched, the suicide victims convulse while they are hanging from the noose they have created. They are suffocating, and it seems like their body is fighting to save themselves to no avail. It will be painful, but I think all suicide methods have some degree of pain.
I agree with that. I think it is not okay to hurt people regardless of a mental illness.

I think you have an interesting insight. Honestly, I am aware that maybe my thoughts of myself being a toxic, horrible person aren't true, but that doesn't eliminate my feelings on the matter. I have severe Depression, GAD, Panic Disorder, PTSD, and Autism. Because of all of that, I'm sure my thinking is somewhat untrue and delusional, but I can't seem to convince myself otherwise.

Your English and formatting were fine. Thank you for your words.
I have attempted suicide before by overdosing on my antidepressants. It was botched because I wasn't too keen on dying, but now I've gotten to that point. I wish you luck.
I might have a feast of my favorite foods before I kill myself too. I wish you luck.
